next_actions.next_action: Design an additive tenant migration with a verified owner mapping, restrictive application/worker roles, RLS and adversarial tests on every sensitive table.
Implement server-side capabilities and membership before enabling team access; test object and operation denial across roles.
Move the remaining legacy publish route through the durable worker; make ambiguous outcomes non-retryable until reconciled.
Test cross-tenant IDs/context/attachments/strategy and enforce isolation below application queries.
Build a complete object/operation attack matrix and run it under restricted PostgreSQL identities with RLS.
Cover every mandatory scenario against all publish entry points with deterministic persisted outcomes.
Close underlying blockers with independently reviewable evidence; do not waive them based on a successful build.
Define one action-risk policy and enforce its confirmation and audit rules across every mutation.
Select identity/MFA integration, preserve account links and sessions during migration, and validate recovery and privilege-change revocation.
Implement provider-specific revocation and transactional local cancellation; test expired state, wrong scope, disconnect races and secret masking.
Extend versioned writes and concurrency tests to account, schedule, strategy, connection and billing boundaries.
Introduce recoverable claim/lease, retry classification and inspect/retry/cancel tooling without replaying ambiguous external actions.
Add endpoint/resource budgets and per-provider quota backpressure with concurrent boundary tests.
Review canonical relational constraints and migrate ownership with reconciliation and rollback evidence.
Supply deployment configuration evidence and separate migration/application/worker identities with least privilege.
Run an approved isolated recovery drill and record restore time, data-loss bound, backup lifecycle and alert ownership.
Document collection purposes, recipients, access and retention for every stored field and review additions against it.
Classify each table, object bucket, telemetry field and export, then map access/encryption/retention controls.
Approve retention periods and implement bounded, observable purge jobs including backup expiry.
Build authenticated owner-confirmed deletion with durable provider, billing, storage and secondary-store reconciliation.
Add owner-authorized export jobs, tenant-bound expiring access and a media archive with deletion lifecycle.
Verify managed encryption and TLS settings and plan application-key rotation with tested recovery.
Inventory secret consumers and establish rotation/revocation procedures and a secret scanner.
Implement private storage delivery, metadata handling and a documented scan/quarantine policy; verify hostile-media tests.
Inventory routes and enforce strict schemas, response allowlists and budgets, with object-level attack tests.
Document every callback, verify signatures/time/schema, and queue idempotent processing with duplicate-event tests.
Inventory remaining server egress and constrain provider upload URLs, DNS resolution, redirects, response size and timeouts.
Move executable inline code to controlled assets/nonces and test CSRF, XSS and browser policy across critical flows.
Exercise every supported format/account/timezone on staging, including unsupported-field warnings and wrong-account prevention.
Add server-enforced confirmation and consequence copy for every high-impact action, with keyboard and screen-reader verification.
Test offline save, refresh, navigation, concurrent edits and recovery for each editor; expose clear save state.
Measure desktop/mobile p95 reads/writes and LCP/INP/CLS under realistic load, then address bottlenecks.
Test all error responses for secrets, outcome clarity, retry policy and recovery action.
Add automated accessibility checks and manual keyboard/screen-reader/contrast review for critical journeys.
Verify editing, review, publishing, errors and analytics at representative mobile widths and input modes.
Bind every AI action to authenticated workspace capabilities and explicit authority; test bypass attempts.
Apply versioned strict schemas and reject extra or invalid action fields before any mutation.
Test hostile source/media/tool data against deterministic authority controls and ensure secrets cannot enter model context.
Capture synthetic outbound payloads and assert minimum approved fields and absence of tokens/billing/other tenants.
Validate approval identity, scope, expiry and content binding for every AI-proposed external action.
Add append-only structured audit records for all critical actions with retention, access controls and tamper detection.
Add minimal security event telemetry and actionable alerts for failed login, denial, privilege and unusual-volume events.
Implement safe structured telemetry, metrics, trace propagation and alert-delivery tests.
Create and propagate server-generated request/job IDs through responses, durable jobs, audit events and telemetry.
Define eligible outcomes and provider-outage accounting; instrument and review SLO/error-budget reporting.
Exercise outages, latency, quota exhaustion and malformed responses per adapter with bounded recovery.
Reconcile legacy paths into one canonical publishing contract and versioned payload model.
Run independent durable workers and persistent private object storage; test multi-instance restarts.
Set per-service pool budgets from the actual database capacity and validate saturation/backpressure under load.
Inventory all caches and verify tenant prefixes, expiry, invalidation and absence of secret payloads.
Validate test/live separation, subscription races, duplicate/out-of-order events and current payment setup.
Define canonical entitlements independent of display plans and test concurrent limit enforcement and changes.
Put internal operations behind verified staff identity/MFA and least-privilege auditable actions.
Establish and verify environment inventory and prevent production data/secret use in development.
Require Production guardrails plus validation checks in branch protection and hosting; add incremental lint/type/security checks.
Produce a reproducible complete dependency lock and validate current vulnerability scans with an update/remediation process.
Verify repository/host controls and require reviewed changes with pinned CI dependencies and least-privilege secrets.
Map critical journeys to each test level and add missing provider/browser security regressions.
Run isolated staged load scenarios and verify graceful overload with no duplicate sends or corruption.
Scope and complete independent security testing after architectural remediation, recording unresolved findings as blockers.
Run an incident tabletop covering detection through postmortem, preserving evidence and customer impact analysis.
Implement the emergency control path and exercise provider revocation/key rotation/affected-account identification.
Document and rehearse database corruption/deletion, region outage, credential compromise and provider failure recovery.
Obtain accountable privacy review and operational evidence; do not infer legal compliance from code tests.
Test telemetry allowlists against synthetic credentials, draft text, emails and secret-bearing URLs.
Gate elevated content access with explicit reason, verified support role and immutable audit.
Expose accurate connection permissions/access and action provenance with clear automation status.
Define and display a versioned automation policy enforced by workers and approvals.

Enforce private storage, MFA prompts and explicit opt-in automation in initial/deployment configuration.
Implement accessible authenticated self-service lifecycle/team/automation controls with recovery and audit.
Assign accountable owners and verify release policy is required in repository and hosting controls.
Install repository/host enforcement and close all applicable product/security/privacy/reliability/concurrency/data/operations checks.
Migrate incrementally to the target architecture with compatibility, recovery and failure tests at each stage.
Require evidence-backed closure, repeat the full release gate on the exact candidate and archive approved release evidence.
Inventory asynchronous actions and test busy, repeated click, timeout, success and retry states.
Inventory and consolidate critical shared controls while preserving Zova branding and tested behavior.
Verify every empty state explains purpose, absence and a usable next action.
Split adapters behind a stable interface and add provider contract fixtures without changing public behavior.
